items.en_oneliner: Managed sessions can now pause while waiting on tool approvals, questions, or Hooks and MCP decisions, and pick up again after a Harness restart through cold recovery.

items.title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
items.en_title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
items.en_oneliner: Hugging Face launched a public dashboard to compare llama.cpp prompt processing and generation speed across hardware, models, and quantization settings on AMD Ryzen and Radeon, and to track performance changes across builds.
items.reason: Official source · Covers benchmark · Published within 24 hours

items.title: Benchmarking coding agents on the work developers bring to Kiro
items.en_title: Benchmarking coding agents on the work developers bring to Kiro
items.en_oneliner: Kiro has unveiled its internal benchmark KiroBench: more than 300 tasks drawn from real development work by Amazon engineers, spanning feature work, bug fixing, refactoring and other multi-turn scenarios, scored in runnable environments with verifiers to sidestep the leakage and narrow coverage of public benchmarks.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Agent and benchmark · Published within 24 hours

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon in GitHub Copilot
items.en_oneliner: GitHub Copilot now offers Google's latest Gemini 4 Neon for agentic coding, multistep tool calls and knowledge tasks.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Gemini and Agent

items.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
items.en_title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
items.en_oneliner: Google has added Tool Retrieval to the Gemini API in preview, letting agents keep a large tool library on standby and load parameter schemas only when needed, cutting input tokens while keeping tool selection accurate.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Gemini and Tools
